I am **Sun Jiahong (Ryan)**, a postdoctoral researcher in bioinformatics and computational biology at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and the Centre for Eye and Vision Research.

My research focuses on computational methods for genetic variant discovery and cancer evolution at single-cell resolution. I am also interested in AI virtual-cell models and in translating complex biological data into mechanistic insight.

## Research interests

- Whole-genome and single-cell DNA sequencing
- Cancer genomics and evolutionary modelling
- Transcriptomics, epigenomics, and multiomics
- Bayesian statistics and machine learning
- Algorithms for biological data
- AI virtual cells

## About this site

This site is a long-term, structured notebook for reproducible research. It combines conceptual explanations, practical tutorials, algorithms, software notes, and reflections from books and language learning.
